note: In/out in source seconds, inside the films' own edits (scdet). A = Mokobara's Transit Z product film (black colourway, 810x1080, 24 fps); C = its 'Time spent digging = 0 seconds' charger-pocket film (900x1080). Every shot keeps the full source width at 1.33x (A) or 1.2x (C) (playbook L16) and drops the burned-in labels by cropping rows: A's labels sit in rows 105-130 and 955-1000, C's caption in rows 85-180. scripts/prep_key.py then keys the white studio sweep out (contact shadows kept) and bakes each frame onto the reel's ground; 'rgba' shots keep the alpha so type can sit behind the bag. 'protect' = MediaPipe magic-touch keypoints (x, y in the output frame) on white things the key would eat (the phone); 'feather' fades a cut edge into the ground.
